description: This file defines a React component 'MoodTrendChart' that visualizes mood data over the last 7 days using bars with color coding and heights based on mood scores. It includes type definitions, utility functions for processing mood entries, and JSX rendering logic.

methods.name: moodToScore
methods.description: Converts a mood string to a numeric score between 1 and 3, representing tense, okay, and calm.

methods.name: buildDailySeries
methods.description: Builds a 7-day series with average mood scores per day, filling in missing days with the last known mood or neutral.
